name: address-validator-archive-age
title_template: [address-validator] audit_log holds rows past retention on {{ host }}
body_template:
The oldest audit_log row on {{ host }} is from {{ oldest }}, {{ age_days }} days ago. AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS is {{ retention_days }}, plus {{ grace_days }} grace day(s), so audit-archive should already have archived and deleted it. Rows past retention still carry raw_input (address PII).

audit-archive has probably stopped running; a failed run would have alerted on its own.

Inspect on the host:
systemctl list-timers audit-archive.timer
journalctl -u audit-archive -n 50
infra/install-units.sh --check
